headline: Gujarat Alkalies explains special window for physical securities transfer
hook: Compliance window for physical share holders
summary: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals has outlined details regarding the special window for the transfer of physical securities. This regulatory procedure affects investors still holding shares in physical form rather than dematerialised accounts. Shareholders must navigate these specific procedural guidelines to regularise their holdings. Indian retail investors with legacy physical shares in listed entities need to follow such compliance updates.
why_it_matters: Physical share holders must comply to transfer legacy securities.
